name: BBoptim
title: Large-Scale Nonlinear Optimization - A Wrapper for spg()

origin.description: Expands method and M, calls spg, and keeps the first successful run.
origin.usage: BBoptim(par, fn, gr=NULL, method=c(2, 3, 1), lower=-Inf, upper=Inf, project=NULL, projectArgs=NULL, control=list(), quiet=FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: Spectral steplengths to try. The default is 2, then 3, then 1.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: M is a vector. The default memory lengths are 50 and 10.

origin.details: The grid is method within M, the same order as expand.grid. The first convergence stops the search.
origin.value: The same list the R function returns for this case.

translation.description: Expands method and M, calls spg, and keeps the first successful run.
translation.usage: bb_optim(par, fn, gr=None, method=(2, 3, 1), lower=-inf, upper=inf, project=None, projectArgs=None, control=None, quiet=False, **kwargs)

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: Spectral steplengths to try. The default is 2, then 3, then 1.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: M is a vector. The default memory lengths are 50 and 10.

translation.details: The grid is method within M, the same order as expand.grid. The first convergence stops the search.
translation.value: A dictionary with the same fields.
